questions.q: Which Portuguese explorer first sailed from Europe to India, in 1498?
questions.why: He sailed around Africa.

questions.q: Which Portuguese navigator led the first voyage around the world?
questions.why: He died in the Philippines; his crew finished the trip.

questions.q: Which prince sponsored early Portuguese voyages of discovery?
questions.why: He lived from 1394 to 1460.

questions.q: Which disaster struck Lisbon on 1 November 1755?
questions.why: It destroyed much of the city.

questions.q: What was the peaceful 1974 coup that ended dictatorship called?
questions.why: Soldiers put carnations in their guns.

questions.q: Which South American country was Portugal's largest colony?
questions.why: Brazil became independent in 1822.

questions.q: Who was Portugal's first king?
questions.why: He became king in 1139.

questions.q: Which explorer first rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488?
questions.why: He called it the Cape of Storms.

questions.q: Which dictator led the Estado Novo regime from 1932?
questions.why: It lasted until 1974.

questions.q: Which 1494 treaty split the newly found lands between Portugal and Spain?
questions.why: It drew a line through the Atlantic.

questions.q: Which Asian territory did Portugal hand back to China in 1999?
questions.why: It had been Portuguese for over 400 years.

questions.q: Which alliance with England, from 1386, is the world's oldest still in force?
questions.why: It was sealed by a royal marriage.

questions.q: Which minister rebuilt Lisbon after the 1755 earthquake?
questions.why: Lisbon's Baixa district is called Pombaline.

questions.q: Which Indian city was Portugal's main colony in Asia until 1961?
questions.why: India took it back that year.

questions.q: Which 1385 battle secured Portugal's independence from Castile?
questions.why: The Batalha Monastery celebrates it.

questions.q: What is the capital of Portugal?
questions.why: It is built on seven hills.

questions.q: Which sweet fortified wine comes from northern Portugal?
questions.why: It is aged in Porto's cellars.

questions.q: Which sad, soulful music style comes from Lisbon?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: Which Portuguese footballer has won five Ballon d'Or awards?
questions.why: He is from Madeira.

questions.q: Which custard tarts are a Lisbon speciality?
questions.why: The ones from Belém are famous.

questions.q: Which painted blue-and-white tiles decorate many Portuguese buildings?
questions.why: They came from Moorish traditions.

questions.q: Which southern region is famous for beaches and cliffs?
questions.why: Faro is its main city.

questions.q: Which salted cod is a Portuguese favourite?
questions.why: There are said to be 365 recipes for it.

questions.q: Which Atlantic island group, far from the mainland, is Portuguese?
questions.why: Its highest peak is Mount Pico.

questions.q: Which Lisbon monument was the starting point for explorers?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which river flows through Porto and its wine valley?
questions.why: The Douro Valley is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which city has one of the oldest universities in Europe?
questions.why: It traces its founding to 1290.

questions.q: Which Portuguese writer won the 1998 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: He wrote 'Blindness'.

questions.q: Which poet wrote under many 'heteronyms' like Alberto Caeiro?
questions.why: His statue sits outside Café A Brasileira.

questions.q: Which epic poem tells of Vasco da Gama's voyage?
questions.why: Luís de Camões wrote it.
